in_marathi.name: Ayus
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayus हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ayus is a Sanskrit name derived from the ancient Hindu text, the Rigveda. It means 'life' and is associated with the Hindu god of life, Ayu Deva. Ayus is a symbol of longevity and vitality.
